collection.title: Chevrolet Tahoe 1999 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chevrolet Tahoe 1999 to 2006 requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.  We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Tahoe which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
